<h1 className={"openapi__heading"}>Preview a data deletion from a timeless account.</h1>

<MethodEndpoint method={"post"} path={"/v1/timeless-indices/{id}/query-hits"}></MethodEndpoint>



Returns the number of documents that [Delete data from a timeless account](https://api-docs.logz.io/docs/logz/delete-timeless-account-data) would delete for the same request. Nothing is deleted.

Must be run with an API token that has the **Admin** role. API tokens created before token roles were introduced have the same permissions as Admin.

Please ensure to change the region in the URL to match your account's region.
